notes: First rules pack: the tables built into Mythoscenarium 0.2.38.

textPresets.name: Artemis 31B v1.2
textPresets.description: Made for roleplay and storytelling, by TheDrummer. Can look at pictures you paste.

imagePresets.name: MOSS-Image
imagePresets.description: Detailed pictures that follow long descriptions well.

imagePresets.name: Stable Diffusion XL
imagePresets.description: The classic, fast and widely supported. Can be shown a character's portrait, and thousands of community versions exist.

imagePresets.name: Flux.1 dev
imagePresets.description: Follows the scene closely and draws believable people and hands. The biggest download, and the story model gets a smaller build next to it.

imagePresets.name: Chroma1-HD
imagePresets.description: A Flux-class model retrained to be uncensored (Apache licence), with strong prompt adherence and a negative prompt that works. Slower than Flux; no portrait reference.

imagePresets.name: HiDream-I1 Full
imagePresets.description: The strictest prompt follower of the open models, and the slowest: 17B weights plus four text encoders. Takes most of the graphics card, so the story model runs partly in system memory. No portrait reference.

promptRules.note: Distilled builds (SDXL Lightning, Turbo, Hyper, LCM): 4 to 8 steps, CFG 1 to 2, or the picture burns.
Pony Diffusion V6 XL model card: score tags first, CLIP skip 2, CFG around 7; rating_safe keeps it clothed.

promptRules.promptPrefix: masterpiece, best quality, newest, absurdres, highres
promptRules.negativePrefix: worst quality, old, early, low quality, lowres, signature, username, logo, bad hands
promptRules.note: NoobAI-XL model card: quality and date tags, CFG 5, CLIP skip 2.

promptRules.promptPrefix: masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
promptRules.negativePrefix: lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, error, missing fingers, extra digit, fewer digits, cropped, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, username

promptRules.promptPrefix: masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
promptRules.negativePrefix: worst quality, low quality, lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, signature, watermark
promptRules.note: Illustrious XL and its merges: booru-style tags, CLIP skip 2, CFG 5 to 7.

promptRules.negativePrefix: bad eyes, cgi, airbrushed, plastic, deformed, watermark
promptRules.note: Juggernaut XL model card: natural-language prompts, DPM++ 2M SDE Karras, CFG 4 to 6, 30 to 40 steps.

promptRules.negativePrefix: illustration, 3d, 2d, painting, cartoon, sketch, worst quality, low quality
promptRules.note: RealVisXL and the photoreal merges: prose prompts, a photo cue, push away from drawings.
DreamShaper XL: CFG 3 to 6 with DPM++ 2M SDE Karras; its lightning build is caught by the first rule.

textRules.note: Roleplay tunes (TheDrummer, anthracite, Sao10K…): temperature 1 with min-p around 0.05 to 0.1 and a light repetition penalty.

textRules.styleNote: Write flowing prose: no headings, bullet points or bold labels.
textRules.note: Gemma model cards: temperature 1.0, top-k 64, top-p 0.95.
Mistral model cards suggest a low temperature (0.3 for Nemo); 0.7 keeps the story lively.

textRules.styleNote: Write flowing prose: no headings, bullet points or bold labels.
textRules.note: Qwen model cards: temperature 0.7, top-p 0.8, top-k 20, repetition penalty 1.05.
DeepSeek recommends temperature 1.0 for creative writing.

recommendations.why: Artemis at a good build next to MOSS-Image, with room for the 16k story memory.
Chroma follows scenes closely and has no content filter, and Artemis still gets a 4-bit build next to it.
